title: Vector-valued product noise operator
statement: Let $V$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $W$ be a real normed vector space, and let $f:V^n\to W$. For $0\le\rho\le1$, define the vector-valued noise operator at $x\in V^n$ to be the expectation of $f(y)$ when $y$ is sampled from the product noise distribution at $x$ with parameter $\rho$.
